extracted.name: Oven BBQ Beef Brisket
extracted.description: This BBQ brisket is cooked slowly in the oven, sliced, and then coated with BBQ sauce and braised until tender, delicious, and full of flavor.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (160 degrees C).
Sprinkle both sides of brisket with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Place in a Dutch oven or large roasting pan with a cover.
Cook in the preheated oven, covered, without adding water, for 3 hours.
Remove brisket from the pan and slice. Return slices to pan. Mix BBQ sauce with water; pour over sliced brisket. Cover the pan and cook for 1 more hour.
